scientific_integrity: Explicit rational two-state matrices, exact finite verification and a provable extension to unused letters; sources distinguished from new nonbinary classification. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Length exactly four; finite alphabet of at least two letters. No claim for longer words or optimal probability gaps. Negative case uses Gill binary theorem and the all-alphabet three-state theorem. Priority not independently certified.
title: Complete four-letter probabilistic automatic complexity over arbitrary finite alphabets
